notes: NAME CHANGED: the congregation now brands itself 'The Canyon Church' (page titles and site navigation on cdobible.org read 'The Canyon Church'; the story page calls it 'The Canyon'). Earlier names - Canyon Del Oro Baptist Church, then Canyon Del Oro Bible Church - are kept in aka, and the domain (cdobible.org), the Subsplash app handle (cdobaptist) and the YouTube handle (@CanyonDelOroBibleChurch) all still use the older names. Affiliation quoted from their own story page: 'a member of the Venture Church Network Southwest (formerly Southwest Church Connection)'. Address 9200 N. Oracle Rd., Tucson AZ 85704 confirmed on the church's own site; coordinates remain neighbourhood-level, so re-run tools/geocode.py if precision matters. YOUTUBE FOUND: channel UCFnl_Rh5XFIMQOorvr9LNPQ, handle @CanyonDelOroBibleChurch, titled 'The Canyon Church'. The on-site sermon archive at cdobible.org/sermon/ is a Subsplash embed that does not render for a plain HTTP fetch, so its speaker labels could not be read - open it in a real browser to get per-sermon preacher attribution. STAFF: Steve Van Kley (Senior Pastor) and Justin Elwell (Associate Pastor) are recorded. The staff page also lists Sam Dyer (Church Plant Pastor) and Andrew Wade (Family Pastor); their titles do not imply regular Sunday preaching, so they are deliberately not listed - check the sermon archive before adding them.
